title: Procedural Lava Shader Effect
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) manually implementing a 3D Simplex/Perlin Noise function in GLSL; (2) noise-based vertex displacement and normal recalculation in the vertex shader; (3) two-layer noise blending and color-ramp mapping in the fragment shader; (4) the EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass post-processing pipeline; (5) real-time GUI control of 6 uniforms; (6) maintaining performance (fps monitoring)
